summary: Job 9742743 received the new mandatory local failure closeout. MatRIS epoch 6 and AQCat25 were screened against exact final VASP force geometries; MatRIS passed, so no fine-tuning was triggered. A periodic-branch-normalized, five-internal-image local O-H path was built, accepted after geometry, dist.pl, and nebmovie.pl 0 review, and packaged as an 80-core ordinary micro-NEB. Preflight passes and the current gate allows SUBMIT_VASP, but the package remains unsubmitted pending explicit remote-execution authorization.

payload.objective: Submit the reviewed job-9742743 local O-H densified ordinary micro-NEB only after explicit user authorization of the current hash-bound bundle.
current_evidence: LSF job 9742743 is DONE but not force-converged: all five internal images reached 300 ionic steps and the maximum final NEB force is 0.194127 eV/Angstrom at image 02.
The failed attempt and confirmed optimizer/path outcome are registered in the strategy-learning store; exact-input retry is blocked.

MZ73 job 1510 compared MatRIS epoch 6 and AQCat25 with exact final job-9742743 image 01-03 VASP force blocks. MatRIS passed the registered screen with force-vector RMSE 0.080373 eV/Angstrom and maximum vector error 0.233732 eV/Angstrom. AQCat25 passed the force/error ceilings but did not reproduce the three-structure lowest-energy ordering. No MatRIS fine-tuning is triggered.
The replacement local path uses normalized periodic branches and five internal images. O-H distances are 2.0320, 1.7800, 1.5500, 1.3200, 1.1143, 1.0500, and 0.9989 Angstrom.
Geometry diagnosis passes, dist.pl gives a maximum adjacent displacement of 0.399207 Angstrom, and nebmovie.pl 0 visual review accepts one continuous O-H bond-forming event.
The 80-core ordinary micro-NEB package passes repository preflight. Its gate decision is READY_FOR_ORDINARY_NEB_SUBMISSION with only SUBMIT_VASP allowed.
